meta.description: Estimated road distances between cities (real-world roads). Estimate, not game data.
meta.basis: Shortest car route between the real-world city coordinates on OpenStreetMap roads (OSRM). ATS uses a 1:20 map scale with game time about 20x faster (SCS blog, The Rescale, 2016), so in-game distances should be close to real road distances; to be checked against in-game job distances.
